verdict.rationale: Visa Intelligent Commerce documents its own rails for agent-initiated purchases at Visa-accepting merchants: agent-specific tokens, purchase-intent mandates, and credential retrieval scoped to a merchant and amount. The Trusted Agent Protocol lets merchants verify and accept agent-driven checkouts. However, no evidence shows first-party checkout inside named assistant surfaces (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Copilot), and the product carries an in-development caveat. Missing for 10: documented integrations with specific chat/assistant surfaces, a merchant-facing in-chat checkout flow or catalog exposure, production availability beyond sandbox, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a merchant, buyers can complete purchases of my products inside chat and assistant surfaces (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Copilot and peers)

citations.quote: A new pass-through payment token, specific to agents, that is intended for use at Visa-accepting merchant locations.
During checkout, your agents display a list of the customer's tokenized cards.
This allows you to confidently welcome agent-driven commerce while protecting your site from harmful bots.
